1.w: A Prayer of David. Incline Your ear, O YHWH; answer me, for I [am] afflicted and in need.

2.w: May You guard my life, for [am] I faithful; may You save Your servant—the one trusting in You—You my God.

3.w: Show favor to me, O Lord, for to You I call out all the day.

4.w: Make glad the soul of Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.

5.w: For You, O Lord, [are] good and forgiving, and abundant in in loving devotion to all those calling on You.

6.w: Give ear, O YHWH, [to] my prayer, and attend to the voice of my pleas.

7.w: In the day of my distress I call on you, for You will answer me!

8.w: None like You [is] among the gods, O Lord, and not like Your works.

9.w: All the nations whom You have made shall come and bow down before Your face, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.

10.w: For You [are] great, and the One doing wonders; You [are] God—You alone.

11.w: Instruct me, O YHWH, [in] Your way, [and] I will walk in Your truth; unite my heart to fear Your name.

12.w: I will confess You, O Lord my God, with all my heart, and I will glorify Your name forever.

13.w: For Your loving devotion [is] great toward me. And You have delivered my soul from the depths of Sheol.

14.w: O God, arrogant ones have risen against me, and a gathering of ruthless ones have sought my life; and they do not set You before them.

15.w: But You, O Lord, [are] a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger and abounding in in loving devotion and faithfulness.

16.w: Turn to me and show favor to me; give Your strength to Your servant, and give salvation to the son of Your maidservant.

17.w: Make with me a sign for good, and those hating me will see it and be put to shame! For You, YHWH, have helped me and comforted me!
